questions.q: Is there much difference ___ British and American spelling?
questions.why: Дві сторони порівняння — *difference between*. *among* і *amongst* — про групу без розрізнення; *in between of* — неграматично.

questions.q: I found my old diary ___ the books in the attic.
questions.why: Серед маси речей — *among the books*. *between* — між окремими двома; *along* — «уздовж»; *beneath of* — неграматично.

questions.q: She was ___ the first students to finish the exam.
questions.why: «Одна з» — *among the first*. *between* — між двома чи окремими сторонами; *through* і *across* не означають «одна з групи».

questions.q: The shop is closed ___ 1 and 2 p.m.
questions.why: Проміжок «від… до…» з *and* — *between 1 and 2*. *among* — про групу; *from* потребує *to*; *during* не поєднується з *and*.

questions.q: Belgium lies ___ France, Germany, Luxembourg and the Netherlands.
questions.why: Кожна країна — окрема сторона, тому *between* навіть із чотирма. *among* і *amid* — серед маси; *around of* — неграматично.

questions.q: This app is very popular ___ teenagers.
questions.why: Поширене в групі — *popular among teenagers* (також *with teenagers*). *between* — не про групу; *with between* і *amid of* — неграматично.

questions.q: We shared the pizza ___ the two of us.
The little cottage stood ___ tall pine trees.
questions.why: Серед багатьох дерев — *among*. *between* — між двома (двома деревами); *along* — «уздовж»; *within of* — неграматично.

questions.q: I can't choose ___ the red dress and the blue one.
There was a feeling of panic ___ the passengers.
questions.why: У групі людей — *among / amongst the passengers*.

questions.q: The meeting will last ___ two and three hours.
questions.why: Числа «від… до…» — *between two and three hours*.

answer: The money was divided among all the volunteers
